messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration for 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area places 12 points at the vertices and edge midpoints of a regular hexagonal lattice (two concentric hexagons), with the 13th point at the center, achieving a minimum triangle area of 1/72. This configuration is optimal because the hexagonal lattice provides the most uniform area distribution among triples, and any perturbation forces at least one triangle below this threshold."}
